### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone

Root: refund on the cash-sale chair given back (customer's own write).
- Hop A — battery: blocked-side sentence (cash_chair_return_refund, "When the refund is fixed"): "The refund on a cash-sale chair given back is fixed only after the chair's service history shows a battery repair job under the manufacturer's warranty for every battery-set replacement completed on it." Records: two battery swaps (customer, 5th and 7th) vs one battery/manufacturer_warranty job (10-05). The write: battery desk card "Each posting adds one battery repair job under the manufacturer's warranty to the chair's service history" — same words as the state. **state-derived.**
- Hop B — controller: "The refund ... is not fixed until the chair's service history shows a joystick and controller repair job under the manufacturer's warranty for every controller replacement completed on it." Records: joystick replaced on the 9th, no such job. Controller desk card: "Each posting adds one joystick and controller repair job under the manufacturer's warranty to the chair's service history." **state-derived.**
- Hop C — drive: "Before the refund ... is fixed, the chair's service history must show a motor and gearbox repair job under the manufacturer's warranty for every drive-unit replacement completed on it." Records: left drive motor on the 11th, no such job. Drive desk card: "Each posting adds one motor and gearbox repair job under the manufacturer's warranty to the chair's service history." **state-derived.**
- No further hops: none of the three desk cards carries a waits-on sentence; repair_responsibility §6 (chair with the patient) holds now (patient_owned) — which also favours posting before the refund closes the record.
- Order: A, B, C (any order among themselves) → root.

### Counter-proofs

- "Do only the refund": excluded by the three "fixed only after / not fixed until / Before ... is fixed" sentences against a service history showing 1 warranty job for 4 completed repairs. Doing so would also price the refund at 20 % restocking with no delivery-fee return (only 1 warranty job; no controller/drive job).
- Days of use to the check-in (12, case 3) excluded: case 3 is "Otherwise"; case 2 applies "When no loaner chair has been delivered and the chair has a repair estimate request".
- Days to the return request via the decision date (12) excluded: delivery-fee doc reads "the requested date of the chair's latest return-pickup request".
- Restocking at the class 20 % excluded by "4 or more | none withheld" after postings.
- Labor units measured to the job date instead of the posting day: same tier in every factor here (robust).
- Base return rule ("unused") excluded: Term 2 "no longer in force for a cash-sale chair given back under the refund rule".
- Oxygen 'portable equipment' E1392: from the class name and oxygen fee schedule; no alternative code.
